status: engineering candidate, not released for manufacture
axial_retention: Structural adhesive in the 0.15 mm nominal socket/web gap fixes axial station. No friction-only retention claim. Pull/shear coupons are required.
adhesive: Unspecified pending PA12 surface preparation, actual bond gap and pull/shear coupon tests
radial_retention: Removable inward socket caps retained by 0.35 mm stainless lockwire in a 0.45 mm groove; CAD models a conservative square-section wire envelope, closure tail excluded.
mounting_webs: CAD-derived rectangular webs: radius ~6.896 mm at +/-24 mm stations, ~19.229 mm at +/-12 mm; sockets follow the actual web slope.
